scoring.otherLabels: Count conservatively against support; do not award uncertain translations/inferences. Source-supported but wrong-referent claims count against context-sensitive grounding.
scoring.nonresponsive: Directly supported but nonresponsive claims are kept separate from question correctness; never treat claim support as case answer accuracy.
scoring.notes: Unsupported or uncertain factual additions in negative notes fail strict no-invention certification.

verdict: Automated thresholds met both runs; strict quality gate NOT fully passed because run2 negative-note factual generalization is not certified. Do not tune using this held-out set.
